name: Briefcase 3 XL
notes: EMS VCS3 with all 256 matrix pins, 0 out/1 in. Missing engine abilities: external audio (input 1 carries keys, input 2 is silent), envelope repeat and decay beyond 10 s, variable sine/triangle shapes, and the 18 dB filter (24 dB here). The scope replaces the meter; speaker switches, headphone/control outputs and keyboard sockets are hardware, not reproduced. Output filters are flat at 0.5; pan is 0 left/1 right.
